Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from today’s Serie A games, Como-Venezia, Frosinone-Torino, Lazio-Cagliari, Lecce-Genoa and Juventus-Napoli
We begin the schedule at 11.30 GMT (12.30 CET) with Venezia’s trip to Como.
At 14.00 GMT (15.00 CET), Frosinone and Lazio host Torino and Cagliari.
Then, at 17.00 GMT (18.00 CET), Lecce face off against Genoa before the evening clash sees Juventus host Napoli as Massimiliano Allegri and Luciano Spalletti face off against their former clubs.
- All
- Favourites 0
Baturina haș his third attempt of the game, but this wild effort goes wide from outside of the box.
Adams fouls Ricci in the Como half. Free-kick given.
Baturina haș another shot from just inside the box, this time it is blocked but Como continue to push for the opener.
Como win another corner after the ball comes off Moreno last, it’s put into the box before falling neatly for Baturina who blasts the ball way over from just inside the box.
Ricci just catches Busio late just inside Venezia’s half, free-kick.
Como been the stronger of the two teams inside the opening 15 minutes but with all their possession of the ball, are still looking for a good chance to break the deadlock.
Lauberbach fouls Kempf in Como’s half, free-kick given.
Foul by Sohm on Paz and Como have a free kick in Venezia’s half.
The second corner is whipped in and met by the head of Kaiki, who sends it high and wide of the goal. Still 0-0 as Como start to turn up the pressure.
Douvikas strikes it from the resulting corner but the shot is blocked and Como win another corner.
A quiet opening five minutes here by the lake. The hosts have seen most of the ball and have just won their first corner of the match after the ball deflects of Hainaut. Neither side yet to show much attacking intensity in the early stages.
Jean Butez keeps his place in the Como goal and Samuele Ricci returns to midfield, while Lion Lauberbach and Gianluca Busio come in for Venezia.
Click here for the full details.
COMO (4-2-3-1): Butez; Couto, Ramon, Kempf, Kaiki; Milla, Ricci; Da Cunha, Paz, Baturina; Douvikas
VENEZIA (3-5-2): Stankovic; Halhal, Juan Jesus, Moreno; Hainaut, Sohm, Busio, Helgason, Mazzocchi; Lauberbach, Adams
digest_he:
חובבי הכדורגל האיטלקי עוקבים אחר משחקי המחזור בליגה האיטלקית בסרייה א, עם סיקור חי הכולל את ההכנות ומהלך האירועים בכל המגרשים.

לוח המשחקים נפתח במפגש שבו ונציה יוצאת למשחק חוץ מול קומו. בהמשך היום, קבוצות כמו פרוזינונה, לאציו, טורינו וקליארי עולות למגרש, כאשר לאחר מכן מתמודדות לצ'ה וגנואה.

מוקד הערב מרכז את תשומת הלב למשחק שבו יובונטוס מארחת את נאפולי, למפגש טעון שבו המאמנים מסימיליאנו אלגרי ולוצ'אנו ספאלטי פוגשים את קבוצותיהם לשעבר.
